creepExplanation.basis: MIT creep L361 explicitly names nuclear reactors and jet engines; the card uses turbines as a standard hot-engine component application. This is a bounded engineering application inference, not a quotation or independent turbine-specific source. It does not add a numerical lifetime, alloy guarantee, or claim about all turbine parts. No factual contradiction found; no FIX solely for this inference.

hydrostatic.basis: L152–156 explicitly state hydrostatic stress has no influence on metallic slip; L112–138 Mises uses stress differences/deviatoric energy. Both notes retain metallic-system/shear scope, so they do not generalize to polymers.
